task_instance: Set up the local unfancy-search pipeline and run one basic web search (query: 'best practices for API rate limiting') through the local server, polling the search-status endpoint until status is 'done' and inspecting the ranked results.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is running web searches through the Bright Data SERP API, which inherently requires a Bright Data account with paid SERP API access (a BRIGHT_DATA_API_TOKEN) and, for the optional query-expansion feature, an Anthropic API key. The safety rules forbid using credentials, account-bound or paid services, so no real search can be submitted or returned. Compounding this, the unfancy-search pipeline code is not bundled with the skill (only SKILL.md is present) and must be cloned from an external git repository whose address is a placeholder standing for an unreachable resource, and the local server/API host it would run is likewise a placeholder; web fetch/clone of such hosts is forbidden and unavailable. The pipeline is a specific external program that is missing/unavailable, so per the run rules I did not write a replacement, stub or mock.
evidence: Read SKILL.md at the skill path. Setup requires: (step 1) git clone of an external repo given only as a placeholder address; (step 2) .env with BRIGHT_DATA_API_TOKEN + BRIGHT_DATA_SERP_ZONE and optional ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; (step 3) docker compose up / pnpm dev to start a local server on a placeholder host. Checked runtime: docker (/usr/bin/docker), node v22.22.0 and pnpm (/opt/node22/bin/pnpm) are available, so the engine isn't the problem. Listing the skill directory shows only SKILL.md present (no bundled pipeline code). The first unavoidable stop is that the search cannot produce any result without a paid Bright Data SERP account token (and the pipeline source cannot be obtained from the placeholder/unreachable repo), both barred by the safety rules. No search was submitted; no files beyond result.json were created in the work directory.
